items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Leroy Kirkland was living in the same building that I was living in, on the same floor, and he rang the bell and asked me if I could make a record date.

ctx.x: And I think this date came up where he couldn't make it and he recommended me to Leroy Kirkland, and so Leroy Kirkland was living in the same building that I was living in, on the same floor, and he rang the bell and asked me if I could make a record date.

Well, I had made no recordings on the outside, other than recording with the bands that I was with, and so I told him yes. Well, I didn't know what kind of music we were supposed to play, but I did have experience as a little boy, when I was around about 10 years old, I used to play at the Church of God on Sundays -- that was my gig, see.
